spans.s: जश् a short term ( प्रत्याहार ) signifying the soft inaspirate class consonants ज्,ब्,ग्,ड् and द्.
जस् case termination अस् of the nom. plural: cf.

जश्त्व substitution of a जश् consonant prescribed by Panini for any con- sonant excepting a semi-vowel or a nasal, if followed by any fourth or third consonant out of the class consonants, or if it is at the end of a pada; cf.
जश्भाव the same as जश्त्व, which see above.
जसि case termination अस् of the nom. plural mentioned as जस् by Panini in
, but referred to as जसि by him; cf.
